10.7cm 射电流量，取值范围约 50–300（低于 50 几乎不出现，300: The 10.7 cm radio flux, ranging about 50–300 (values below 50 hardly occur; 300 is a possible upper limit)
K≥5 为磁暴，HF 传播明显恶化。: K ≥ 5 is a geomagnetic storm, and HF propagation degrades markedly.
M/X 级会引发短波中断（黑子活动强时）。: M and X classes can cause shortwave fadeouts (when solar activity is high).
SFI 中等，HF 中低波段稳定可用。: Medium SFI: the lower and middle HF bands are reliably usable.
SFI 偏低，仅较低波段可用。: Low SFI: only the lower bands are usable.
SFI 高、A/K 低，HF 各波段普遍开放。: High SFI and low A/K: the HF bands are generally open.
低谷年份则依赖较低波段（40m/80m/160m）进行远距离通信。: In trough years, long-distance communication relies on the lower bands (40 m/80 m/160 m).
地磁暴会使极区吸收增强、MUF 下降，同时可能带来极光散射通信机会。: A geomagnetic storm increases polar absorption and lowers the MUF, while possibly opening up auroral scatter opportunities.
太阳活动约 11 年一个周期，峰值年份 HF 高波段（10m/12m/15m）传: Solar activity follows a cycle of about 11 years; in peak years the higher HF bands (10 m/12 m/15 m) propagate best.
数值越高，HF 高波段传播越好。: The higher the value, the better propagation on the higher HF bands.
数值越高，传播条件越差（磁暴）。: The higher the value, the worse the propagation (geomagnetic storm).
磁暴或耀斑爆发，短波中断。: Geomagnetic storm or flare: shortwave is disrupted.
黑子越多，电离层电离越强、MUF 越高。: More sunspots mean stronger ionisation and a higher MUF.
